settings_registry_terminal_click_to_move: Click the prompt line to move the cursor there. Needs shell integration (fast terminal only).
settings_registry_terminal_clipboard_des: Lets commands such as tmux or ssh sessions put text on your clipboard.
settings_registry_terminal_contrast_desc: Brighten or darken text that is hard to read against its background (fast terminal only). 1 turns it off, 4.5 meets accessibility guidance.
settings_registry_terminal_copy_on_selec: Copy selected text to the clipboard when you release the mouse.
settings_registry_terminal_description: How terminals and coding agents draw and behave: renderer, font, cursor, padding and clipboard.
settings_registry_terminal_font_thicken_: Draw terminal text slightly heavier, like Ghostty's font-thicken. Helps thin fonts on dark backgrounds.
settings_registry_terminal_gpu_descripti: Draws local terminals on the graphics chip: smoother scrolling and faster output.
settings_registry_terminal_host_restart_: Restart the background process that keeps terminals alive, to pick up a new Atlas version.
settings_registry_terminal_ligatures_des: Join characters like -> and != into single symbols (fast terminal only).
settings_registry_terminal_option_as_alt: Make {key} send Alt instead of typing macOS characters (fast terminal only).
settings_registry_terminal_scrollback_me: Most memory one terminal spends on its scrollback, in MB. A wide terminal keeps fewer lines than the setting above to stay inside it (fast terminal only).
settings_registry_terminal_term_font_des: Font families in order; the first one installed wins, else JetBrains Mono. Variable fonts work.
settings_registry_terminal_term_padding_: Space left and right of the terminal text, in points. The margin uses the terminal background.
Space above and below the terminal text, in points. The margin uses the terminal background.
settings_registry_terminal_term_size_des: Text size in terminals, in pixels.
